tools.name: access_explain_verdicts
tools.description: Return the five verdicts this index can return, what each one means for an agent that has just been refused, and what the agent's next move is for each. Costs nothing and makes no request; call it once to interpret access_check_url results.

tools.name: access_list_agents
tools.description: Return the AI crawler tokens this index reads robots.txt rules for — only tokens their operators document — plus the widely-written tokens that no operator sends, which make a robots rule unenforceable. Useful when writing or auditing a robots.txt.
